name: @graph-motor/render
description: Draws a graph-motor snapshot. Input is snapshot bytes; output is pixels on a canvas the host owns. No runtime dependency, no framework, no motor import. Ships no build: import the .ts sources from src/ (there is no index), or bundle them.
//toolchain: No devDependencies of its own: it type-checks, lints and tests with the toolchain installed in app/ (scripts/studio.sh check).
